name: Ganaxolone
summary: Ganaxolone, sold under the brand name Ztalmy, is a medication used to treat seizures in people with cyclin-dependent kinase-like 5 (CDKL5) deficiency disorder. Ganaxolone is a neuroactive steroid gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) A receptor positive modulator.

pharmacology.text: The neurosteroid modulation of GABAA receptors by progesterone-derived metabolites such as allopregnanolone was first characterized in the mid-1980s by Majewska and colleagues, who demonstrated potent enhancement of GABAergic inhibition by these endogenous steroids (1986–1987). Subsequent review articles in the late 1980s and early 1990s further established this mechanism, providing the conceptual basis for later synthetic analogs such as ganaxolone.

uses.text: Ganaxolone is indicated for the treatment of seizures associated with cyclin-dependent kinase-like 5 (CDKL5) deficiency disorder.

sideEffects.text: The most common side effects of treatment with ganaxolone include somnolence (sleepiness), fever, excessive saliva or drooling, and seasonal allergy.
